comparison: Report all seeds and median/range of evaluation MAE and RMSE, validation-selected epoch, negative forecasts, native latency, owned buffer bytes and total study wall time. Equal training steps, not equal compute or individually tuned models. No automatic deployment or accuracy promotion.
interpretation: Keep the smallest model unless larger capacity gives useful repeatable accuracy benefit for its measured cost. This exploratory curve cannot establish fresh generalization, alpha or an open-source speed frontier. Linux benchmarking remains deferred.

latency.measurement: Fresh serial native worker per cell, after all training and parity preparation. Preloaded FP32 inputs; model loading and Python feature conversion excluded. No concurrent builds, training or profiling. Record all raw samples; report median of nine worker p50/p99 values per width and ranges. Desktop tails are observations, not deadlines.
latency.order: Each trial and seed cyclically rotates widths; each width occupies each position once per seed over three trials

training: Fresh runs for every width; inherit eight epochs, three seeds, four heads, 48-hour context, all data/scaling/optimizer/selection/parity rules from demand_v1. Change only width, hidden width and child experiment id. No outcome-dependent extensions.
